name: Peace and Quiet Palisades 2025

venue.name: Palisades Center
venue.address: 1000 Palisades Center Dr, West Nyack, NY 10994
venue.details: 4th Floor, Harry & Thelma Adler Community Room

information: This competition only has the blindfolded events and Fewest Moves. If you're looking for a more conventional cubing competition, you might be interested in [this one](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PBsinPalisadesOpen2025). Due to the limited space, each competitor can bring at most 1 guest during the competition. The Harry & Thelma Adler community room is located on the 4th floor in front of the Ice Skating Rink on your right hand side. This competition is a fundraiser for [Flushing Town Hall](https://www.flushingtownhall.org/) ____________________________________________________________________________________________________________
